event_records.description: The petition organizers have 400 signatures and continue their signature collection efforts.
The quarry operator's counter-flyer is in circulation, opposing the petition.

petition_organizers.name: Petition organizers
petition_organizers.persona_brief:
You are Petition organizers.
They have gathered 400 signatures in the first fortnight, mostly at the farmers market. They aim to collect 1,500 signatures total to trigger a council debate. They are aware of the six-week deadline and the counter-flyer from the quarry operator.

quarry_operator.name: Quarry operator
quarry_operator.persona_brief:
You are Quarry operator.
The operator distributed a counter-flyer last week opposing the petition. They employ 85 residents and have an interest in preventing the petition from succeeding.

resolution.question: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 1,500 valid signatures were submitted to the council before the deadline (2026-09-14T17:00:00-06:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
